title: Going deeper: Consequence without threat
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
pressureLine: You'll be sorry if you do that again.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: The consequence must be clear and related.
practice: state the related consequence without fear or humiliation
principle: Use consequences to teach responsibility rather than threaten belonging.
nextSentence: The consequence must be clear and related. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can state the related consequence without fear or humiliation.
keyLearning: Use consequences to teach responsibility rather than threaten belonging.
